title: Assistant recommending specific funds to buy

acceptableCauses.mechanism: A compliance-filter config change at 11:40 IST (advice_score_threshold 0.55 -> 0.85) stopped blocking direct advice; the block rate collapsed.

notes: The filter, not the generator, is the control that failed.
